saw.short: Dua Lipa, Tame Impala and SZA headline Coachella 2027
saw.headline: *Dua Lipa*, Tame Impala and SZA headline Coachella 2027
saw.what: Coachella has named Dua Lipa, Tame Impala and SZA as its 2027 headliners, on 9-11 and 16-18 April. BBC News says Dua Lipa is the first solo British woman to headline. Variety and Billboard report passes go on sale on Friday 13 Nov at noon PT.
saw.why: A British pop star at the top of a global festival bill. Expect line-up reactions and memes.

saw.short: Greggs opens a hotel suite with a sausage roll hotline
saw.headline: *Greggs opens a hotel suite* with a sausage roll hotline
saw.what: Greggs has opened a permanent suite at Newcastle’s Hotel Gotham, where guests lift a gold rotary phone to order a sausage roll on a silver platter. It sleeps two and costs from £335 a night, per Famous Campaigns. Greggs is also giving away a stay through its app every three months for two years.
saw.why: A brand stunt that only works because of its sense of humour. Strong for photos.

saw.short: Boxed GTA 6 copies arrive with a code, not a disc
saw.headline: Boxed *GTA 6* copies arrive with a code, not a disc
saw.what: Boxed GTA 6 copies have started arriving, with a download code and a poster inside rather than a disc, per Metro and Push Square. Some pre-orderers got theirs a day early. The pre-load is 212GB on PS5 and the game launches on Thu 19 Nov.
saw.why: Unboxing clips are doing the work before launch. Game launches are now a social event.

saw.short: Owain Wyn Evans's Children in Need ride passes £1.2m
saw.headline: Owain Wyn Evans’s *Children in Need ride* passes £1.2m
saw.what: BBC Radio 2’s Owain Wyn Evans had raised more than £1.2m for Children in Need at the end of Wednesday’s Day 3 of his nearly 400-mile four-nations cycle. The ride finishes in Cardiff on Friday 13 Nov, which is also appeal night. A BBC One film follows on Friday 20 Nov at 7.30pm.
saw.why: A feel-good story with a clear finish line. The total will keep rising.
saw.source: BBC live page, 11 Nov; On The Radio

saw.short: Rivals returns for part 2 on Disney+
saw.headline: *Rivals* returns for part 2 on Disney+
saw.what: Rivals series 2 part 2 arrived on Disney+ on Wed 11 Nov with a three-episode premiere, then weekly on 18 Nov, 25 Nov and 2 Dec, per indy100. Metro reports some fans criticised one storyline. Reviews of part 2 are mixed, with Hello marking it down.
saw.why: A Disney+ show is trending on release week. Useful for any Disney channel.

platform.short: Meta explains how Facebook's Your Algorithm controls work
platform.headline: Meta explains how Facebook’s *Your Algorithm* controls work
platform.what: Meta’s engineering blog says new interests get extra weight for a limited time, and an LLM builds the interest profile. Requests such as less AI-generated content use separate demotion signals rather than topic matching. The tool was announced in October, and Meta lists no countries.
platform.why: Meta shows how topic controls shape the feed. Not confirmed for the UK.
platform.source: Meta Engineering, 10 Nov; Social Media Today, 11 Nov

platform.short: X previews labels that explain AI moderation decisions
platform.headline: X previews labels that explain *why its AI flagged a post*
platform.what: X’s head of brand safety previewed designs for labels that would tell users why X’s AI flagged a post, how its reach was limited, and let them appeal, Adweek reports. It was shown at the Brand & AI Safety Summit on 10 Nov. It is a design preview, not a confirmed rollout.
platform.why: Brands get a clearer view of moderation. Nothing live yet.
platform.source: Adweek, 10 Nov; Social Media Today, 11 Nov

platform.short: LinkedIn tests a frequent viewer label
platform.headline: LinkedIn tests a *frequent viewer* label on profile views
platform.what: LinkedIn is testing a “frequent viewer” label for some Premium users, showing when someone has looked at their profile repeatedly, Wired reports. LinkedIn confirmed the test but shared no further details. It isn’t a confirmed rollout.
platform.why: Another reason for page admins to check what their profile views show.
platform.source: Wired, 11 Nov; Social Media Today, 11 Nov
